k9.reason: GraphicView reserves compoundPath as null among its non-shape elements ("Reserved but not supported in graphic component") and takes the class of such a type from that table instead of getShapeClass, so new Clz fails and the documented element cannot be created.

Graphic elements receive transform/shape/style through applyUpdateTransition and only silent, ignore, invisible and autoBatch through applyMiscProps; GraphicView never reads focus, blurScope or progressive.
updateCommonAttrs assigns cursor, z, zlevel and z2 only to non-group elements; the graphic component has no diffChildrenByName handling.
ZRender draws images with drawImage only; image style binding sets shadow properties and never fills or strokes.
ZRText copies fill, stroke, lineWidth, lineDash and lineDashOffset to its text spans, but not lineCap, lineJoin or miterLimit.
ZRender ArcShape has cx, cy, r, startAngle, endAngle and clockwise; there is no inner radius.
ZRText.setTextContent throws in development builds and does nothing in production: a text element cannot carry another text element, although GraphicView calls setTextContent for every element.
